conditions.percentiles: Nearest-rank p50 and p95; CPU comparison per-process medians use 7 samples.
conditions.cpu_active: build_snapshot start through submit return; excludes snapshot, upload preparation and waits
conditions.gpu_interval: Whole Graph including readback; excludes presentation
conditions.cold_upload: Pre-created immutable meshes; explicit chunk upload acceptance and completion, not total level load time
conditions.memory: Final registered/reserved logical mesh bytes, pending/cache bytes and VMA allocation/block bytes are distinct
conditions.limits: One GPU/driver; no clock, affinity, power or OS load control; fixed shader/UNORM; no FPS or PBR claim

correctness.measurement_limits: CPU active excludes capacity waits; GPU includes readback, excludes presentation. Observed latency starts after submit return and ends at completion observation, not scanout. No clock/affinity/power control or performance baseline.

performance.measurement_limits: CPU active excludes capacity waits; GPU includes readback, excludes presentation. Observed latency starts after submit return and ends at completion observation, not scanout. No clock/affinity/power control or performance baseline.

cpu_index_comparison.scope: CPU metadata investigation; real public Engine registration and Graph export declaration, plus std-only production cache index versus prior linear-selector model; no Vulkan object creation, staging, submit or GPU work
cpu_index_comparison.order: AB/BA/AB; seven freshly empty logical registries per case in each child process
cpu_index_comparison.conditions: Clock, affinity, power and external OS load not fixed; input generation and final owners destruction outside timed regions; no fixed timing thresholds
cpu_index_comparison.cache_limits: Entry eligibility in baseline model uses bool/refcount metadata; production selector path included directly via graph/cache.rs. Event queue lock/Arc/Vulkan/native allocation are excluded; warm case includes removal and reinsert of all acquired candidates. Small sets may cost more in indexed model.
cpu_index_comparison.probe_replay_note: The exact executed sources are embedded here. Write both UTF-8 strings to a temporary folder, change the probe path attribute to the adjacent cache source, and link the same probe against each recorded source commit CPU release renderer library. The cache selector comparison is an isolated metadata model, not Vulkan execution. Path-only edits change the probe hash; recorded hashes describe the original executed files.

replay.library_build: cargo build --release --locked -p renderer --no-default-features (in each source worktree)
replay.library_variables: Absolute FullName of the sole librenderer*.rlib in the respective CPU-only target/release/deps directory.
replay.cache_module: The same NEW cache module is compiled into both probes. The before argument selects the prior linear metadata model; public Engine/Graph code comes from the corresponding linked renderer rlib.
replay.execution: Invoke the matching executable with sole before/after argument and retain all CSV output. Seven samples per case; 147 rows per process; 882 total. No explicit CPU warm-up.
